newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG, IBM Korea to form PC unit.
newsitem.headline: LG, IBM Korea to form PC unit.

text.p: LG Electronics, a unit of South Korea's LG Group, will set up a joint venture with IBM Korea to make and market personal computers, an informed industry source said on Monday.
The joint venture, LG-IBM Co, will be capitalised at 24 billion won, the source told Reuters.
The source said IBM Korea would hold a 51 percent stake in the joint venture and LG the remainder.
"The joint venture will be in charge of business planning, manufacturing and marketing of PCs in Korea," the source said.

IBM Korea now markets computers made outside the country, while LG electronics makes computers for the domestic market and for export. The joint venture will absorb the domestic business of both companies, while LG would continue to make computers for the export market, the source said.
LG and IBM Korea will announce details of the venture at 10.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) on Tuesday.
Spokesmen for LG Electronics and IBM Korea confirmed the two companies would form the joint venture, but declined further comment.
